report.summary: For pet hair, hands-on testing from RTINGS, Consumer Reports, and Wirecutter points to bagged canister and high-suction cordless sticks as top performers, with robots for daily maintenance. SEBO Airbelt K3 Premium excels on carpet and bare floors with 7-10 year warranty, Dyson V15 Detect leads cordless per RTINGS May 2026 testing, and Roborock Q7 M5+ offers affordable self-emptying robot cleaning at $220-$300. Handheld Black+Decker HHVK515JP07 and Ryobi 18V stick fill niche needs, while Narwal Freo X10 Pro adds mopping for muddy paws.

products.name: Dyson V15 Detect
pros: RTINGS expert-domain testing names it best vacuum cleaner for pet hair we've tested (May 14 2026)
Laser detection helps see fine pet hair on hard floors per RTINGS methodology
Strong carpet and bare-floor debris pickup that correlates with pet-hair performance per Consumer Reports guidance
cons: Premium price tier typically $700+ without source-confirmed discount in our notes
Bagless bin requires frequent emptying with heavy shedding and exposes dander
Battery aging risk - 28% of cordless stick vacuums 2015-2025 had battery issues per Consumer Reports survey
products.verdict: Hands-on testing by RTINGS (May 14 2026, expert-domain) confirms Dyson V15 Detect as top pet-hair performer across carpet and hard floors. It's the safest all-around pick if you want one cordless stick to handle heavy shedding, despite bagless maintenance and long-term battery aging risk.
